scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,bank,web -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:bank" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.dev:backend: node scripts/py.mjs --cwd backend -m app.server --migrate-only && node scripts/py.mjs --cwd backend -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --reload-dir app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 3000
scripts.dev:bank: node scripts/py.mjs --cwd mock-bank -m uvicorn mock_bank.main:app --reload --reload-dir mock_bank --host 0.0.0.0 --port 4000
scripts.test: npm run test:py && npm run test -w shared
scripts.test:py: node scripts/py.mjs --cwd backend -m pytest && node scripts/py.mjs --cwd mock-bank -m pytest
scripts.typecheck: npm run lint:py && npm run typecheck:py && npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.lint:py: node scripts/py.mjs -m ruff check --config backend/pyproject.toml backend mock-bank scripts && node scripts/py.mjs -m ruff format --check --config backend/pyproject.toml backend mock-bank scripts
scripts.typecheck:py: node scripts/py.mjs --cwd backend -m mypy && node scripts/py.mjs --cwd mock-bank -m mypy
